endorsements.name: Mark Kennedy
endorsements.label: CMX:  IEEE Clean File Metadata Exchange
endorsements.description: False positives are a huge problem in the security space.  Organizations can spend more time and engineering on reducing FPs than on detecting new malware.  Whitelists can help, but there are difficulties with these.  Many organizations will not permit the exchange of files for copyright reasons.  3rd party developers must deal with multiple security vendors to get their software whitelisted.
